The '''Oben system''' was located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oben]], a colony of the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Oben [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]], which placed the system in grid square J-4.<ref name="EAOC" />
